axes.label: Centreline topology
axes.basis: Checksum-pinned standardized SWC nodes, parent links, and exact segment coordinates.
axes.limitation: Constant-width viewer strokes are display aids; no membrane is observed.

axes.label: SWC neurite types
axes.basis: Deposited SWC source-type codes are preserved per node and segment.
axes.limitation: Source type 6 remains uninterpreted; type labels do not establish molecular identity.

axes.label: Axon field
axes.limitation: No axon primitive is added beyond an admitted source type-2 field; unavailable is not biological absence.

axes.label: Diameter / radius input
axes.basis: Official attributes report Diameter and the admitted radius summary is positive and complete.
axes.limitation: Cross-paper shrinkage and acquisition are not harmonized.

axes.label: Radius-derived display surface
axes.limitation: The radius-derived renderer receives zero authorized primitives.

axes.limitation: No primitive or biological assertion is generated.
